title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
abstract: arXiv:2608.16873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 sim

translated_title: 一种基于解析先验的框架，用于高效预测矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器降噪频率的数据效率提升方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16873v1 公告类型：新 摘要：高保真有限元模拟可以为侧支谐振器提供准确的数值预测，但生成大规模模拟数据集成本高昂，且当模拟标注数据稀缺时，纯数据驱动的替代模型可能变得不可靠。本研究开发了一种基于解析先验的学习框架，该框架重用低成本解析模型，以在有限的高保真模拟预算下提高数据效率。研究考虑了两种互补路径。当推理时解析模型仍可用时，将其保留为显式基线，模拟数据仅用于学习解析模型与模拟之间的差异。当需要自包含预测器时，首先从大量低成本评估中将解析映射蒸馏为学习先验，然后使用有限的模拟数据进行校准。该框架在矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器上使用86个模拟样本进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于解析先验的学习框架，通过重用低成本解析模型或蒸馏其先验，在有限的高保真模拟数据下显著提高矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器降噪频率预测的数据效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model or distills its prior to significantly improve data efficiency for predicting sound-reduction frequencies in rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators under limited high-fidelity simulation data.
